manifest.rule: bus 24 + train 24（去掉与 bus 重叠）+ 其他/背景 16；按天气 round-robin，组内路径字典序；对照按路径 md5 等距抽样；不足不用 val 补足
manifest.revision: np2r-1：修正网格/像素坐标混用、weight=[N] 广播、缺少逐批与梯度校验
manifest.loss_units: Per batch mean native scalar: gained cls/box/DFL, shared target_scores_sum. Dataset totals sum batches (not an image mean).
manifest.legacy_cls_units: Legacy cls_pos/cls_neg were BCE/target_scores_sum without hyp.cls gain; saved explicitly alongside gained fields.

precision.note: Forward uses historical precision; only backward convolution TF32 disabled. Tolerance unchanged at1e-4; diagnosis evidence supervision_tf32_diagnosis.json.

gradient.interpretation: Gradient norm ratios are nonadditive; mean/sum of per-batch norms are not a joint-dataset gradient norm.

v4.notes: 正 anchor 来自单次原生联合分配；cls_pos/cls_neg/box/dfl 为同一 loss 的按类别分解，未重新分配。target_weight_total 只描述「这 64 张诊断样本中有多少监督」，不等于整个训练期的监督量。梯度只报告范数与向量一致性，不把范数比例当作可加和的贡献率。
